specification:
Build a RAICA (RAG AI Context Agency) where users interact with a ChatGPT-like interface that serves as a frontend to ~/Development/flaskserver and OpenAI API LLMs.

The interface has three panes:
- Left sidebar: Settings icon, conversation history list, and user profile at bottom
- Middle pane: Chat window with streaming responses, file upload button, copy/regenerate/save buttons for each response
- Right sidebar: Agent list with interactive forms for each agent
- Bottom status bar: Shows agent execution status with stop/cancel controls

Users can:
- Register and log in with email/password
- Chat with LLM models with streaming responses
- Upload files and download generated content
- Run specialized agents from the right sidebar
- Track conversation history and switch between conversations
- Manage settings and user profile
- Monitor agent execution in real-time

The system manages: posts, streamed responses, prompts, conversation history, agent outputs.

Special requirements: Email notifications for agent completion, file uploads and downloads for chat attachments and agent outputs.

UI Style: User friendly, responsive, and pretty interface with modern design patterns.
